// diagnostic E0962

Jet.RejectOutsideTemplate

`reject` runs only inside a marker's `expand` template or `check` rule.

What

`reject` runs only inside a marker's `expand` template or `check` rule.

Why

`reject(value)` raises a diagnostic at a marker's use site while the compiler expands the marker, or at a call its `check` rule hears; ordinary code has no use site to report at, so the call has nothing to run.

Fix

Move the check into a marker's `expand: fn(self, target: Target)` or `check: fn(self, call: CompilerCall)` body, or return an error value from this function instead.
